hero.subtitle: A free live webinar for adoptive families on guiding children with both compassion and structure.
hero.description:
This webinar focuses on helping children succeed through connection, encouragement, and emotional safety rather than fear-based discipline.

Families will explore executive functioning challenges, motivation, and healthy boundaries while learning how to guide children with both compassion and structure.

countdown.heading: The live session begins in
countdown.live: We're live now. Come on in.
countdown.ended: This session has ended. Register to get the replay.

forYou.heading: This is for you if...
items: You want to guide your child's behavior without relying on fear-based discipline.
You're navigating executive functioning challenges and don't know where to start.
You want your child to feel safe and connected, while still having healthy boundaries.
You're looking for practical tools that combine compassion with real structure.

learn.heading: What you'll walk away with
items: How to help children succeed through connection and emotional safety.
Ways to support executive functioning and motivation.
How to set healthy boundaries without losing connection.
How to guide with both compassion and structure.

guide.name: Bryan Post
guide.bio: Bryan Post is an internationally recognized expert in adoption, attachment, and trauma, and the founder of the love-based, family-centered approach behind our program. For decades he has helped families move from fear and conflict toward connection, calm, and lasting healing.

trust.heading: Why families trust this webinar
trust.audience: Join adoptive and foster families from across California, supported by the Fear to Love methodology and the Love Pathways Wraparound team.

items.title: Connection over fear
items.desc: Why emotional safety, not fear-based discipline, is what helps children succeed.

items.title: Executive functioning & motivation
